mean_side_double_count.detail: DESI applies no subtraction (main.tex:459); our mean term is the only mean model and is largely shape-ineffective (5 percent whitened-mismatch reduction, sign-opposed on 665/681 rows); it does not meaningfully compensate DESI's unsubtracted bias

variance_side_double_count.detail: two live pricings of the same NAMED unknown, 10 percent directional overlap in the deployed metric, 0.80x duplicate pricing along the envelope direction, ~5 percent of n_s posterior variance per device; conservative in direction; conditional on the open shape identity; disposition = document, do not repair

gate_b_dosing.detail: exactly one envelope dose; paired design correct; in-cov term prices variance not the mean; quoted ratios ~3 percent conservative

ledger_denomination.detail: booking the full coherent-arm number without noting the 40 percent covariance-priced share double-reports at the ledger level

truth_population_vs_injection.detail: prior self-draw truth identical in both arms; paired delta responds to e_dla alone

adjudications.campaign_classification: envelope stress test: ~1 sigma per z block, joint chi2 10.71 (~3.27 sigma) under DESI's stated z-block model, 74 percent of the derived same-radius worst case; a 1-sigma realization only under the fully z-coherent reading R0
adjudications.producer_asymmetry: DESI's own cosmology fit (arXiv:2601.21432, verbatim) removes HCD + resolution modes from its cov and floats them; we do it for resolution only and keep the DLA mode while floating alpha_dla; both sanctioned by DR1 recommendation 3; ours more conservative
referee_corrections_adopted: cov_syst recipe closed: 5 outers + 2 diagonal add-terms exact
shape-identity conditionality on every same-unknown sentence

twelve_answers.q1_meaning: Primary referent: P(DESI DR1 concordance CNN/GP finder flags a real DLA) ~0.85; the name covers six distinct objects; sim finder 0.971 never valid in DESI budget contexts
twelve_answers.q2_how_measured: Wang+2022 CNN validation on synthetic DESI mock spectra, DR1-summarized as ~85 percent with no stated uncertainty and no z/NHI/SNR resolution propagated; high-confidence rerun was a purity check, not the estimator
twelve_answers.q3_latent_quantity: the residual unmasked-DLA population (1-C) times its P1D response: one physical unknown re-represented six ways; the two response shapes' shared parent is asserted, not measured
twelve_answers.q4_functional_form: DESI: scalar 0.15 x fitted (k,z) template into a per-z rank-1 cov mode; ours: scalar 0.10 at z=3 pivot x rigid sim z power law through R_DLA; NHI axis absent on both sides
twelve_answers.q5_alpha_dla_represents_mean: amplitude yes (compression valid to 3.6 percent, center at -0.41 latent sigma of DESI-15); shape mostly no (capture ceiling 19.7 percent under any z-reparam, deployed 10.4 percent)
twelve_answers.q6_empirically_calibrated: no: PI design assumption (commit 1e1b278) from the literature >90-percent-complete figure, never fit; width is a hardcoded latent 1.0 that covers the documented 0.05-0.30 range (a coverage check, not a calibration)
twelve_answers.q7_duplicate_or_differ: approximates the same intended object at an inconsistent value (1.5x below DESI's 0.15, +0.41 latent sigma, in-support); as uncertainty it duplicates the in-C envelope only partially (10 percent overlap, 0.80x along-envelope); the mean role is not duplicated
twelve_answers.q8_column_statistically: phenomenological 1-sigma envelope = assumed scalar 0.15 x smooth Eq-4.1 fit to the measured mask-none-vs-masked fractional excess (real data) x P_smooth; = |dP/dC| DeltaC only under pro-rata (plausibly overstating); sign discarded at the outer product
twelve_answers.q9_cov_syst_nature: a probability model in form (zero-mean Gaussian, one k-correlated latent per z block, cross-z exactly zero by convention) built from envelope-grade inputs (the 15 percent has no stated uncertainty)
twelve_answers.q10_campaign_nature: envelope stress test; ~1 sigma per block, joint ~3.27 sigma under DESI's stated model, 74 percent of the derived same-radius worst case; 1-sigma realization only under fully z-coherent R0
twelve_answers.q11_floated_e_dla: double-counts if floated on the shipped C_data; clean if paired with C_data -= sum_z outer(e_dla|z) (SPD-verified; exact in-repo resolution precedent + producer precedent); single z-coherent amplitude additionally asserts z-coherence DESI did not ship
twelve_answers.q12_ledger_quantity: the triple in sigma_clean: typical R1 ~0.10 calibrated (R0 ~0.24 if z-coherent), as-run arm 0.21-0.28 at joint 3.3 sigma (74 percent efficient), derived worst case 1.36x arm; always with the 40-percent-already-priced note and the z-coherence caveat; never the bare 3.3-vs-1 dichotomy
